violation_type.title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space -Gates Locked (26 TAC §744.2957)
violation_type.typical_finding: At the time of follow up the caregivers do not have the key to unlock the gate for the outdoor area to easily exit. This results in there only being one exit.
